answer: Each epoch auctions 100 entry slots by sealed bid at the jetty. The top 100 pay a clearing price of 40 credits and receive an ivory seal binding the slot to one key; losers are refunded. An attacker bidding for many slots bids against itself: each extra bid lifts the price by a delta of 2, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,039,000 credits against a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 999,000. Rented bids fail: seals cannot move keys. An honest agent pays 40 once.
